keyPoints: Daab (pressure) matlab ikai kshetrafal par lagne wala bal; nukili keel aasaani se ghus jaati hai kyunki chhote kshetra par daab bahut zyada hota hai.
Hawa ka bhaar hota hai — dharti ke chaaron taraf hawa ki parat apna bhaar daalti hai, jise vayumandaliya daab kehte hain aur barometer se naapa jaata hai.
Garm hawa halki hokar upar uthti hai aur thandi bhari hawa uski jagah leti hai — isi aavagaman se hawa (wind) chalti hai.
Samudra ke upar garm hawa tez ghoomkar chakravat (cyclone) banati hai jo tez hawa aur bhari barish se tabahi macha sakta hai.
Aandhi-toofan se bachne ke liye mausam vibhag ki chetavni sunna, kamzor pedon se door rehna aur surakshit pakki jagah sharan lena zaroori hai.
Drav me gehraai badhne par daab badhta hai — isi liye bandh ki deewar neeche se moti banai jaati hai taaki paani ka daab seh sake.
Aam galti: hawa ka bhaar nahi hota ye manna; ek khaali aur ek bhare gubbare ko tolkar dekho, bhara gubbara bhari milega — yehi hawa ka bhaar hai.

title: Daab, Hawa, Aandhi aur Chakravat
